title: LPS preconditioning attenuates inflammation-associated social behavioral changes and hippocampal glial reactivity in male mice
title_zh: LPS预处理抑制雄性小鼠炎症相关的社交行为改变和海马胶质细胞反应
abstract: Abstract Neuroinflammation contributes to brain dysfunction and behavioral abnormalities relevant to psychiatric symptoms. Here, we show that lipopolysaccharide (LPS) preconditioning attenuates hippocampal glial reactivity and attenuates the inflammation-associated reduction in social preference in male mice. Mice received low-dose LPS preconditioning (0.2 mg/kg for two consecutive days), followed by high-dose LPS challenge (5 mg/kg) seven days later. LPS preconditioning attenuated the LPS-induced increase in the TSPO/IBA1 signal ratio in the hippocampal CA1 region and attenuated the LPS-induced reduction in social preference. LPS challenge reduced locomotor activity irrespective of preconditioning, and sickness-related behavioral changes may therefore also contribute to the observed behavioral phenotype. In an exploratory experiment using a chronic corticosterone model, LPS preconditioning attenuated the corticosterone-induced increase in marble burying and the upregulation of hippocampal Il1b expression. When preconditioning was delivered during depletion of CSF1R-sensitive myeloid cells using PLX3397, attenuation of both the behavioral change and the increase in the TSPO/IBA1 ratio was no longer detected, although depletion was partial and the myeloid compartment had not returned to control levels at the time of sampling. These findings are consistent with a requirement for CSF1R-sensitive cells during the induction phase of preconditioning, but peripheral and central myeloid populations cannot be distinguished by this approach. Flow cytometric and transcriptomic analyses further revealed that LPS preconditioning altered the composition of TMEM119/CD45-defined brain macrophage subpopulations. TMEM119-positive CD45-intermediate cells increased in proportion after preconditioning, and enrichment of lipopolysaccharide- and NF-κB-related terms was confined to this population. The functional roles of these subpopulations were not tested. These findings indicate that LPS preconditioning attenuates the inflammation-associated reduction in social preference and alters the composition and transcriptional state of brain myeloid cells. This study provides evidence that prior modulation of innate immune cell states can influence inflammation-associated behavioral outcomes, and identifies the cell populations responsible as a question for future work.
abstract_zh: 摘要 神经炎症导致脑功能障碍和与精神症状相关的行为异常。本研究显示，脂多糖（LPS）预处理可抑制海马胶质细胞反应并抑制炎症相关的社交偏好减少。小鼠接受低剂量LPS预处理（两天内每天0.2 mg/kg），随后在七天后接受高剂量LPS挑战（5 mg/kg）。LPS预处理抑制了海马CA1区TSPO/IBA1信号比例的LPS诱导性增加，并抑制了LPS诱导的社交偏好减少。LPS挑战无论是否预处理均降低运动活性，因此观察到的行为表型也可能受 sickness-related 行为改变的影响。在使用PLX3397耗竭CSF1R敏感髓系细胞的慢性皮质酮模型的探索性实验中，LPS预处理抑制了皮质酮诱导的 marble burying 增加和海马Il1b表达的上调。当预处理在CSF1R敏感髓系细胞耗竭期间进行时，行为改变和TSPO/IBA1比例的增加均未被检测到，尽管耗竭程度部分，且在取样时髓系细胞 compartment 尚未恢复到对照水平。这些发现与髓系细胞在预处理诱导阶段的必然性一致，但通过此方法无法区分外周和中枢髓系细胞群体。流式细胞术和转录组分析进一步揭示，LPS预处理改变了定义为 TMEM119/CD45 的脑巨噬细胞亚群的组成。预处理后TMEM119阳性CD45中间细胞比例增加，且NF-κB相关的转录本丰富仅限于该亚群。这些亚群的功能作用未被测试。这些发现表明，LPS预处理抑制炎症相关的社交偏好减少，并改变脑髓细胞的组成和转录状态。本研究提供了证据，表明先天免疫细胞状态的先前调节可影响炎症相关的行为结果，并确定了负责的细胞群体，这为未来的研究提出了问题。
